wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode =Basketball |year =2022–23 |team =Illinois Fighting Illini |image =Illinois Fighting Illini logo.svg |image_size=150px |conference=Big Ten Conference |short_conf= Big Ten |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=20–13 |conf_record= 11–9 |head_coach=[[Brad Underwood]] |hc_year= 6th |asst_coach1=[[Chester Frazier]] |ac1_year = 2nd |asst_coach2= Tim Anderson |ac2_year = 2nd |asst_coach3= Geoff Alexander |ac3_year=2nd |stadium=[[State Farm Center]] |champion= |tourney=[[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result= First Round | off_scheme = | def_scheme = |captain = Luke Goode |captain2 = Coleman Hawkins}} {{2022–23 Big Ten Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign|University of Illinois]] in the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Led by sixth-year head coach [[Brad Underwood]], the Illini played their home games at the [[State Farm Center]] in [[Champaign, Illinois]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They finished the season 20–11, 11–9 in [[2023–24 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in a four-way tie in fifth place. As the No. 7 seed in the [[2023 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they were defeated by [[2022–23 Penn State Nittany Lions basketball team|Penn State]] in the second round. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 9 seed in the West Region, where they lost to [[2022–23 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]] in the First Round. ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team|Illini]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 23–10, 15–5 in [[2021–22 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in a tie for the regular season championship. As the No. 1 seed in the [[2022 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they were defeated by No. 9 seed [[2021–22 Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball team|Indiana]] in the quarterfinals.{{cite web | url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/gametracker/recap/NCAAB_20220311_IND@ILL/ | title=Jackson-Davis leads Indiana past No. 16 Illinois 65-63 | work=[[CBS Sports]] | date=March 11, 2022 | accessdate=July 13, 2022 | archive-date=April 1, 2022 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220401041710/https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/gametracker/recap/NCAAB_20220311_IND@ILL/ | url-status=live }} They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 4 seed in the South Region, where they defeated [[2021–22 Chattanooga Mocs men's basketball team|Chattanooga]] in the First Round before losing to [[2021–22 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] in the Second Round.{{cite web | url=https://sports.yahoo.com/ncaa-tournament-illinois-overwhelmed-by-houston-bows-out-in-2nd-round-again-182454020.html | title=NCAA men's tournament: Illinois overwhelmed by Houston, bows out in 2nd round again | publisher=[[Yahoo Sports]] | date=March 20, 2022 | author=Cooper, Sam | accessdate=July 13, 2022 | archive-date=April 26, 2022 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220426081833/https://sports.yahoo.com/ncaa-tournament-illinois-overwhelmed-by-houston-bows-out-in-2nd-round-again-182454020.html | url-status=live }} ==Offseason== In a preseason scrimmage, Luke Goode broke his foot.
